review_findings.details: npm run test:core:unit reports ReferenceError: React is not defined at CoreProjectAdminControls in project-admin-controls.tsx when renderToStaticMarkup invokes JSX. Add the smallest explicit React import compatible with the existing tsx setup and rerun the tests.
